argument:
The bear’s strongest points are the unresolved margin guide and absent price confirmation, both conceded. The revenue beat does not settle leadership concerns. Nevertheless, newly reported operating strength is direct evidence against assuming the governance shock has already destroyed customer demand.

Extreme weakness is not a buy signal; it makes the eventual resolution highly consequential in either direction. My optimistic case therefore remains conditional on governance clarity, margin explanation or an observable trend repair. No unverified P/E or rebound forecast is needed to preserve that upside possibility, but none of those conditions is claimed complete.
rebuttal_to_previous: Concede active decline and unknown margin compression; latest official operating results rebut an already-collapsed demand thesis, not the timing objection.
